title.fr: Énergie cinétique et théorème de l'énergie cinétique

formula: ΔE_c = Σ W(F_ext)   (théorème de l'énergie cinétique)
sketch:
Observe: SVG scene of a cart accelerated by a constant force F over
distance d; student sets m, v₀; Eₖ = ½mv² gauge fills in real time
alongside the moving cart. Work done W = F·d displayed; théorème
Eₖ_final − Eₖ_init = W verified live. Experiment: 3 seeded target Eₖ
values; student picks m and v to hit. Evaluate: gauge hidden; student
picks m, v from numeric Eₖ target alone. Wrinkle: introduces the
théorème de l'énergie cinétique explicitly at 3ème depth.
